Which of the following dietary modifications would decrease this patient's respiratory quotient?

opb. Increasing carbohydrate intake, decreasing protein intake
opc. Decreasing carbohydrate intake, increasing fat intake
opd. Decreasing carbohydrate intake, increasing protein intake
ope. Decreasing fat intake, increasing protein intake
